notes: Filter window results through a CTE or subquery; PostgreSQL has no QUALIFY clause.
JSONB objects model nested fields; JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS and UNNEST expand JSON and native arrays respectively.
Window defaults do not make LAST_VALUE see the full partition. A CTE organizes logic and does not guarantee materialization or faster execution.
QUALIFY can filter computed window results. An equivalent nested query may be appropriate for portability.
Do not infer warehouse pruning, join strategy or CTE behavior from a PostgreSQL fixture plan.
SAFE_CAST supports casting failures to NULL. SAFE. is not interchangeable with SAFE_CAST or a prefix on UNNEST.
